body:
there's a scarf in "all too well." you know the one -- left there at your sister's house. and taylor has said, out loud, that the scarf is "a metaphor."

then, at a 2022 film festival, she started to explain what it's a metaphor *for*: "we turned it red because red is a very important color in this album, which is called red. and, i think when i say it's a metaphor... i'm just going to stop." the most taylor thing she could have possibly done.

here's the deep cut though. the song that became her most-analyzed lyric started as an improvised rant -- a ten-to-twenty-minute emotional vamp over four chords at a 2011 band rehearsal, trimmed down to the 5:28 you know by heart. it was never released as a single. it debuted at no. 80. and it became the beating heart of the whole record anyway.

longlivets.com
